name: awesome-humans-website
description: Formatting and checks for every file in this repository: run just check. The site itself builds with Python: see pyproject.toml.

scripts.format: prettier --prose-wrap preserve --write "**/*.{md,json,jsonc,yml,yaml,css,js,mjs}" && uv run taplo fmt && uv run ruff format
scripts.format:check: prettier --prose-wrap preserve --check "**/*.{md,json,jsonc,yml,yaml,css,js,mjs}" && uv run taplo fmt --check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.lint: markdownlint-cli2 && stylelint "pages/**/*.css" && eslint && uv run ruff check && uv run actionlint && uv run zizmor .github/workflows
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run spell
